executive_summary: This collection window (March 16-22, 2027) is the thirty-ninth archived window. The Fall/Winter 2027-28 women's ready-to-wear fashion month logged last window (fw27-28-rtw-fashion-month) had already concluded before this window opened -- Paris's leg closed March 9, per FHCM's published calendar -- so no new runway content originates inside these dates. Reachable coverage this window consists of post-season trend-confirmation roundups (WGSN-style catwalk-trend summaries and general editorial recaps) restating themes already logged last window -- sheer/transparent layering (organza, tulle, muslin at Valentino under Alessandro Michele, and layered sheers at Dior and Chloe) and a 'human craft vs AI' framing emphasizing artisanal, hand-made techniques over digitally-generated aesthetics. This is treated as a single new low-confidence signal (source_id fw27-28-post-season-trend-confirmation) rather than an extension of last week's fashion-month signal, since it is retrospective trend-forecasting commentary, not new runway or designer-origin content. Per SKILL.md workflow note 10, the Wales Bonner/Hermes debut question and the CFDA Fashion Fund/Awards questions remain untracked pending new information and were not re-litigated; brief checks found no new coverage on either. Haute Couture Spring/Summer 2027 was checked again for post-show coverage and again found none reachable, unchanged from the prior seven windows. On balance this window is thin: the fashion month itself has closed, and the only in-window discourse found is secondary trend-confirmation commentary restating last window's findings rather than new, independently verifiable in-window content.
